name: Libord Securities Ltd

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
LSL is involved in securities trading, investment, and offering financial and corporate advisory services. Its advisory services include assignments such as mergers and acquisitions, demergers, takeovers, amalgamations, representation to government authorities and regulatory institutions, arbitration, and corporate finance.
